message.content: {"correct":1,"supported":1,"correct_reason":"The final answer provides both the gross IPO proceeds (3,366,000,000) and the estimated net proceeds (~$3.27 billion) and these figures are supported by retrieved DoorDash prospectus passages.","supported_reason":"The numbers cited (gross proceeds of 3,366,000,000 and net proceeds of ~3.27 billion) have exact matching support in the retrieved passages (Front matter table showing 3,366,000,000 and USE OF PROCEEDS stating ~$3.27 billion).","evidence_sufficiency":"full","failure_categories":[],"failure_reason":"", "evidence":[{"chunk_id":"b_paragraph-d95ac10cf359a9ca8749","quote":"Initial public offering price |  | $ | 102.00 |  |  | $ | 3,366,000,000 |"},{"chunk_id":"b_paragraph-8812844f4eb0a12b2a53","quote":"USE OF PROCEEDS\n\nWe estimate that the net proceeds to us from the sale of shares of our Class A common stock in this offering will be approximately $3.27 billion, based upon the initial public offering price of $102.00 per share and after deducting underwriting discounts and commissions and our estimated offering expenses."}]}
